scope: Published equation-verification values, not measured reactor transients. These are applied to the production native kinetics with explicitly changed benchmark parameters and feedback disabled.

source.title: B. D. Ganapol, A Precision Benchmark Suite for Nuclear Reactor Point Kinetics Equations via CATS (2024)
source.tables: Tables 2a/b, printed p.17; Thermal Reactor I parameters in Table A.II, printed p.56
source.provenance: Numerical values transcribed from the 12-place BEFD/CATS columns and cross-checked against the pre-existing browser benchmark transcription. Expected values are not computed by OpenPWR.

initialPrecursorNormalization: All six normalized precursors equal initialNeutronFraction. Compare n(t)/n(0) with the published n(0)=1 result; linear homogeneity justifies the scale change while keeping the coupled thermal model cold.
